correctness.rationale: Over F_3((t)), quartic Q^2=t^2 R is the Auer–Top family λ=t² by the polynomial identity modulo 3. The complete intersection Q=tw,w²=R is proper flat, and its t=0 fiber over F9 consists of Q=0,w=±i(x²-y²), two smooth conics intersecting at precisely four F3-rational transverse nodes. Completing squares gives étale-local uv=t² at each node, so the minimal regular model has four exceptional components and graph K_{2,4}. Frobenius swaps original conics, fixes nodes, and induces -I on cycle rank three; the torus is (Res^1_{F9/F3} Gm)^3 with 4³=64 rational points. The reduced K_{2,4} Laplacian has exact Smith factors 1,1,2,2,8, hence geometric component group (Z/2)^2⊕Z/8. Independently checked char-3 defining identities, four nodes, exact SNF. Distinguishes arithmetic F3-points of torus, geometric component group, and unknown rational component subgroup.
